verdict_note: Strong GTM and cross-functional leadership; lacks direct product marketing title and fintech domain experience, but messaging/positioning and sales enablement expertise are solid.

breakdown.note: 8+ years GTM/growth leadership meets experience floor; held AGM role with P&L, but no direct PMM title. Manager-level positioning is solid but not exact PMM trajectory.

Owns messaging, positioning, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, cross-functional GTM, data-driven KPI dashboards. Missing: thought leadership content creation, campaign-level copywriting, launch narrative specifics.

EdTech D2C is different from B2B fintech infrastructure (Stripe's Global Selling). No payments, currency, or enterprise SaaS experience. Transferable: multi-market expansion, international pipeline, positioning at scale.

Demonstrated GTM velocity: 38% CAC improvement, 25–40% conversion/retention lifts, international pipeline growth, sales enablement systems that drove 42% productivity gain. Metrics are strong but not payment/fintech-specific.
Requires H1B sponsorship; currently on OPT. Stripe is large public company with sponsorship capacity, but visa requirement is a friction point in hiring process.

top_signal: Owned end-to-end GTM P&L with proven ability to redesign positioning for messaging-market fit (25% sales lift), rebuild sales enablement systems (42% productivity gain), and drive international expansion—directly mirrors Global Selling role scope.
biggest_gap: No fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS experience; EdTech D2C funnel is a different buyer journey and sales motion than Stripe's enterprise/mid-market infrastructure play. Will require domain ramp-up on currency presentment, merchant pain points, and competitive landscape.
